name: Endan Tokugawa Kouryuuki ~Gorakuin~
original_name: 艶談・徳川興隆記 ～ごらくいん～
source:
Main character occasionally activates time machine and gets to 1582, right after Oda Nobunaga is ambushed and killed. The purpose in this work is to take decisions so that the wars in the country are eliminated and stability establishes for 300 years to come.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公偶然启动时间机器，来到1582年，也就是织田信长在本能寺之变中遇袭身亡后不久。本作的目标是做出一系列抉择，平息全国战乱，并让此后300年的天下保持安定。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
